references.text: Balaam's prophecy about Amalek, who will be destroyed, linking to Joshua's victory over Amalek.
The command to remember what Amalek did to Israel and to blot out their memory, following up on this first conflict.
Saul is commanded to strike Amalek and complete the judgment that began with Joshua's victory.
David defeats the Amalekites and continues the fight against this people whom Joshua first fought.
The Amalekites and Canaanites defeat Israel when they try to enter the land without the Lord's blessing, in contrast to the victory at Rephidim.
Joshua is chosen by Moses to lead the battle against Amalek, setting the stage for the victory in verse 13.
Fulfillment of the war against Amalek: From Joshua's first victory to Saul's final execution of judgment.
